description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot component that acts as an adapter to connect a DeviceManagementService with an event bus implementation. It uses dependency injection to wire the service, extending the EventBusDeviceManagementAdapter class.

classes.name: AutowiredDeviceManagementAdapter
classes.description: A Spring Boot component that injects a DeviceManagementService into an event bus adapter implementation, enabling device management functionality within an event bus setup.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Setter method that injects a DeviceManagementService instance into the adapter using Spring's @Autowired and @Qualifier annotations.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves the injected DeviceManagementService instance, used internally by the adapter.
